Full cross-entropy is quotient cross-entropy plus L_v=E H(k(.|U)); L_root=E L_leaf, so all terminal spectator entropy is retained once. A previously certified quotient controller price transfers unchanged, without asserting the quotient spectra are Boolean. Matching source/reference conditionals is necessary and sufficient for zero omitted conditional KL. Common independent Boolean factors in every core including fallback satisfy the hypothesis; a certified factor entropy/influence bill is charged once. At any fresh uniform query outside spectator block Z, DeltaL=I(branch;S_Z|T)-I(S_i;S_Z|T), hence [DeltaL]_+<=2 Inf_i(f)/ln(2). If source/reference likelihood p/q is a positive function of retained quotient frequency T on their whole support, actual coherent transport produces Bayes children with matching conditional spectator laws and no extra conditional KL reset; the quotient reset and terminal debts remain. The actual first-data-query h3 example has correction 1-(3/8)log2(3)>0, so unchanged controller cancellation does not extend to arbitrary data queries. Full FEI and arbitrary nonmatching conditional-reference payment remain open.

exact_statement: At one fresh uniform Boolean query, with parent source p and dominating normalized reference q whose erased laws p_e(T,Z),q_e(T,Z) have identical support, apply the same actual coherent branch kernel K_b to both. The actual and inherited Bayes children have matching conditional spectator laws Z given T if and only if L(T,Z)=p_e/q_e is constant on each connected component of the graph joining erased Z vertices supported by a common branch at fixed T. For two branches an ambiguous supported vertex connects the row; disjoint branch supports allow different component likelihoods. The erased conditional KL equals the transported conditional branch KL plus the physical mean inherited-child conditional KL, retaining the source account once. The balanced two-bit AND sign with a tilted positive reference has nonconstant erased likelihood and exact matching children. For selectors choosing +1 or r-bit parity with its negative sign flipped at mask1, mu=2^(1-r), a=mu^2, tilted erased-empty reference mass alpha, and inherited child empty probability beta=alpha*a/(1+a-alpha), mean child conditional KL is one half D_2(Ber(a)||Ber(beta)). At alpha=1/4 this equals a*(ln3-2/3)/(2ln2)+O(a^2). At alpha=1-a^2 it equals (1-2a)/2 log2((1-a)/a)=r-1+o(1), whereas removed selector influence tends to1/2. The full-support r6 Boolean/member reference gives child conditional KL>4599/1024>8*(31/64). Root source KL equals retained outcome plus child KL exactly; both terminal entropy and influence remain. This refutes only an unconditional removed-influence price for arbitrary such tilted inherited references, not a prescribed occupancy bound or FEI.
